jonny-desktop.task: meristem CI: run the Godot engine assertions in CI (linux) so behavioural checks guard every push, not just local runs
jonny-desktop.note: DONE + PUSHED, awaiting merge. PR #15 (branch ci/godot-engine-assertions, commit ead07f8), CI green ubuntu + windows py3.12. PR #14 merged as 45b67ed first, so not stacked. CI now RUNS the Godot engine assertions on Linux: pinned GODOT_VERSION in one workflow-level place, cached download, MERISTEM_GODOT exported via GITHUB_ENV, install step ends with --headless --version so a bad download or missing shared library fails under its own step name rather than as a confusing test error. Godot 4.6 ran headless on ubuntu-latest with NO extra apt packages needed. One OS on purpose: these assert game logic, not platform behaviour, and the rest of the suite already covers both. VERIFIED THAT THEY ACTUALLY RAN rather than the job merely passing - ubuntu went from 198 passed / 13 skipped to 203 passed / 8 skipped (five more tests), the log prints RAN: Godot engine assertions, and the only Godot-related skip is the visual capture with its intended reason. Seven behavioural assertions plus the compile/import/run smoke test now guard every push: move_speed, melee_damage, ability_damage, ability_cost, gear_bonus, loot_drop, room_transition. WHY THIS MATTERED: three real bugs this session were invisible to CI and green - a melee attack_range of 22px against the ~24px two colliding 16px bodies actually settle at (the swing could never hit a touching enemy), an input-timing flake in the harness where a single-frame press-then-release could miss the is_action_just_pressed window, and an ability `cost` read by the runner but never baked so every ability was free. FIXED A GATING BUG FOUND WHILE DOING IT: MERISTEM_GODOT alone gated two capabilities with different requirements. The assertion loop runs under true --headless and needs only the binary; the visual loop runs Godot WINDOWED on purpose because --headless uses dummy drivers that do not render (dec-0007), so it needs a display. Turning the assertions on in CI would have turned on a capture that cannot possibly work on a display-less runner. The visual test now also requires a display - DISPLAY on POSIX, always true on Windows - so it still runs on a real desktop and skips in CI instead of failing. Checked the capture code BEFORE pushing, which is what surfaced this. Decision recorded as dec-019-a72b. REMAINING GAPS unchanged: narrative, economy and items.rarity_tiers still unread (rarity does not affect drop odds despite looking like it should); no inventory or unequip, a second weapon silently replaces the first; only atk/def bonuses consumed so an item granting hp or spd validates and does nothing; dropped items land where the enemy died with no placement validity check so loot can land in a wall or on water; turn_based_combat emits nothing; no attack animation in the humanoid archetype; engine assertions do not run on Windows; visual capture unguarded by CI entirely; GODOT_VERSION must be bumped in step with the engine the templates target and nothing enforces that pairing. RECOMMENDED NEXT: merge PR #15, then either give loot a placement check so drops cannot land in a wall (small, and the fight-loot-equip loop is now the main path players walk), or start on inventory/unequip so found gear can be compared rather than silently replacing what you wear.
